title: 法巴首席经济学家：经济为何能扛住加息，家庭与企业资产负债表健康
speaker: Luigi Speranza

segments.en: How will the economy absorb these? And the probability then that we might get an easing cycle earlier than expected.
segments.zh: 经济将如何吸收这些？以及我们可能比预期更早进入宽松周期的概率。

segments.en: I know that's looking way way ahead, but how do we need to be thinking about the next 24 months of global growth?
segments.zh: 我知道那是很远的展望，但我们需要如何思考未来24个月的全球增长？

segments.en: I think the economy has proven very resilient to a number of shocks.
segments.zh: 我认为经济已证明对一系列冲击非常有韧性。

segments.en: If you think about the target first, if you think of the energy shock, the reality is that the economy is still running about trend a bit everywhere.
segments.zh: 如果你先想想目标，想想能源冲击，现实是各地经济仍大致在趋势水平运行。

segments.en: So I think, despite the rate of high price, which I think will be delivered mostly, the economy will remain resilient.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，尽管高利率，我认为大部分会实现，经济将保持韧性。

segments.en: Why? I think there are a number of factors here, but households and corporate balance sheets are very healthy.
segments.zh: 为什么？我认为这里有几个因素，但家庭和企业资产负债表非常健康。

segments.en: So I think that we're able to withstand the shock from higher interest rates.
segments.zh: 所以我认为我们能够承受更高利率带来的冲击。

segments.en: Even if you increase rates at the speed that the pace has petted, I think monetary policy will still remain a de-margin supportive.
segments.zh: 即使你以已经加快的速度加息，我认为货币政策仍将处于边际支持状态。

segments.en: We've seen a significant increase in the neutral rates here.
segments.zh: 我们看到这里中性利率显著上升。

segments.en: So I don't think the intention is actually to slow the economy again just to prevent everything.
segments.zh: 所以我不认为意图实际上是再次放缓经济，只是为了预防一切。

segments.en: I say fiscal policy supportive. There is a high demand.
segments.zh: 我说财政政策是支持性的。有很高的需求。

segments.en: So I guess the economy will actually surprise and prove resilient again to the data in monetary conditions.
segments.zh: 所以我猜经济实际上会令人惊讶，并再次证明对货币条件数据有韧性。

segments.en: So we are likely to be with anything. It's a frame that way it's a good problem to have.
segments.zh: 所以我们很可能处于任何情况。这样看，这是一个好问题。
